thread:
Priya (CS): quick dump from last 10 onboarding calls — grouping into pain vs feature asks. trying to capture things that hit renewal or block rollouts.
Marco (CS): love it. paste the short list and i'll flag the urgent renewal signals.
Priya (CS): compact CSV snippet: 
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
northbound,self-serve-org,feature,high,needs org-level invite & default routes
helio,onboard-checklist,feature,medium,new customer confused about required config steps
atlas,session-resume,bug,medium,users lose context after reconnects
flux,embed-ttl,feature,low,old vectors bloat store, want retention policy
```
Lina (PM): self-serve org is big. what exactly does northbound want?
Priya (CS): they asked for: 1) create org via console + invite team members, 2) default per-team route templates, 3) ability to pin billing to org level. renewal mention in the call.
Marco (CS): northbound renewal in 6 weeks — if we can promise self-serve org in pilot form they might convert to annual.
Zoe (Eng): quick note: org creation + invite flow is mostly UI + auth glue. billing pinning touches billing tables & policies. rough: org + invite spike 4 days, billing pin 2 weeks.
Lina (PM): propose two-phase approach: M1 ship org-create + invites (pilot), M2 tackle billing pin and templates. will we accept CS pilot constraints?
Marco (CS): yes, pilot is fine. we'll coordinate with northbound and provide acceptance testing.
Priya (CS): onboard-checklist ask from Helio is interesting — they want an in-console checklist that marks completion and shows missing items that block usage. small UX. can we scope as a checkbox list with links to docs?
Zoe (Eng): that's low-effort, could be a single-page component and a per-account progress state. estimate 3 dev days incl. backend flag.
Lina (PM): slot checklist into next sprint as a quick win; will include analytics hook so CS can see progress.
Priya (CS): atlas session-resume bug — users losing conversation state when reconnecting during long calls. sounds like websocket reauth + KV cache TTL mismatch.
Zoe (Eng): agree, probably KV cache key renewal issue. i'll open a spike for reproducer. estimate fix 1 week.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-4601 "self-serve org pilot (northbound)" assigned to @zoe.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-4602 "onboard checklist (console)" assigned to @zoe.
Marco (CS): can we attach the two strongest customer quotes to each ticket? examples: 
- "We need to invite entire squads quickly, can't do it one-by-one." — Northbound
- "A checklist would have saved our first integration day." — Helio
Priya (CS): done, quotes + call links added to both tickets and flagged as renewal-impact. Lina — please confirm prioritization.
Lina (PM): confirmed: checklist = high priority, org-create = highest for Q rollouts, session-resume fix = medium-high. will add acceptance criteria.
Zoe (Eng): i'll start the org-create spike tomorrow and post a short RFC in #eng-platform. will include auth flow and data model.
Priya (CS): i'll reach out to Northbound + Helio with expected ETA and a staging link once we have a prototype. thanks team. :seedling:
